script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl11_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
		    if dialog.show("Level11-1", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level11-2", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("58-1")
			if dialog.show("Level11-3", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level11-4", faceShijin) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl11_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
